home.hook-text: Still looking for answers about your child's health?
home.seo-title: Kseniia Gunina — Pediatrician, Allergist-Immunologist and Dermatologist for Children
home.seo-description: Online consultations with a pediatrician, allergist-immunologist and dermatologist. Lab result review, weaning support, atopic dermatitis, personalized vaccination schedule. In-person visits in Gatchina, Russia.

duration.question: What's included in an online consultation and how long does it take?
duration.answer: A 30–60 minute video or audio consultation: reviewing your concerns and lab results, planning next steps, and answering your questions. After the appointment, you get two weeks of chat follow-up.

countries.question: How can I book a consultation?
countries.answer: To book an online consultation, use the form available via the "Book a consultation" button in the banner on the homepage, or on the "Online consultation with a pediatrician and allergist-immunologist" service page. To book an in-person visit in Gatchina, call the phone numbers listed in the contact blocks next to the map.

second-opinion.question: Can I get a second opinion on a diagnosis?
second-opinion.answer: Yes, this is one of the most common reasons people reach out: we review the existing diagnosis and treatment plan, and I can suggest an alternative examination plan if needed.

in-person.question: How does an in-person visit in Gatchina work?
in-person.answer: Book in advance for a visit at ul. Khokhlova 9 or ul. Khokhlova 8 (Gatchinskaya KMB and "Medikom") — opening days and hours are listed in the address cards on the site.

dermatitis.question: Do you treat children with atopic dermatitis and allergies?
dermatitis.answer: Yes, dermatitis, food allergies, and other types of allergies are part of the core practice alongside pediatrics, both in-person and online.

lure.question: Where do I start with introducing solids to my baby?
lure.answer: Timing, the order of foods, and readiness signs all matter — mistakes early on often show up later as food refusal or allergies. A step-by-step month-by-month plan and the most common mistakes are covered in the video course "Intro to Solids".

pollen.title: Pollen Map: 5-Day Allergen Forecast
pollen.subtitle: Shows the forecast for allergenic plant pollen concentration, along with plant images, pollen index, flowering season, cross-reactions, and recommendations for allergy sufferers.
pollen.seo-title: Pollen Map: 5-Day Allergen Forecast — Allergist Kseniia Gunina
pollen.seo-description: Interactive pollen concentration map with a 5-day forecast. How to prepare an allergic child for pollen season — advice from a pediatric allergist-immunologist.
pollen.map-hint-step-1: Tap the area you're interested in on the map (the forecast covers roughly a 1×1 km area for up to 5 days ahead).
pollen.map-hint-step-2: Data may be unavailable for some areas — in that case, try picking the nearest available area instead.

facts.education: Graduated from Saint Petersburg State Pediatric Medical University in 2015 and completed a pediatric internship there in 2016.
facts.additional: In 2019, completed professional retraining courses in allergology and immunology at Mechnikov North-Western State Medical University.
facts.member: Member of EAACI, WAO, the Union of Pediatricians of Russia, and RAAKI; attendee of the WAO Allergy Congress 2022 and EAACI lectures.
facts.diagnosis: Diagnosis and treatment based on international guidelines.
